description: Minutes approval workflow: submit, approve (issue), return, correct.
precondition: Minutes in the needed status; approver and secretary actors.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
Draft revision with UpdatedAt T; the caller read it at T.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the Draft revision; actor: the current Secretary; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Status WaitingApproval with SubmittedBy = the Secretary and SubmittedAt = now; 200 MSG424.
cases.log: Saved: status, submitter and times on the revision; notification "Biên bản chờ duyệt" to the current Chair ("Thư ký đã gửi biên bản cuộc họp "…" để Chủ toạ duyệt.").

preconditions: Actor reads no meeting (not organizer, approver or participant).
cases.inputs: minutesId: the Draft revision; actor: the stranger; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Failure NotFound; 404 with no message code; status unchanged and nobody notified.

cases.inputs: minutesId: a Draft revision; actor: deactivated Secretary; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Failure Inactive; 403 with no message code; status unchanged and nobody notified.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Chair.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the Draft revision; actor: the current Chair; loadedAt: T.

preconditions: Meeting still InProgress; actor is the current Secretary.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the Draft revision; actor: the current Secretary; loadedAt: T.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the waiting revision; actor: the current Secretary; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Failure Locked; 409 MSG400; a sent revision is not sent again.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary.
Draft revision read at T, then saved by someone else.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the Draft revision; actor: the current Secretary; loadedAt: T.

preconditions: Ended meeting; actor is the current Secretary; Draft revision read at T.
The database fails while saving the transition.
cases.inputs: minutesId: the Draft revision; actor: the current Secretary; loadedAt: T.
cases.return: Failure SaveFailed; 503 MSG404; status unchanged and nobody notified.
cases.log: Error logged with the action and minutes id.
